context: Applies HigherOrderCognitionService's developmental-stage machinery (docs/spec/BRAIN_DEVELOPMENTAL_INTELLIGENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 4) to the seven cognitive-extension modules (affect, executive, circadian, theory_of_mind, hedonic, perception, motor) merged in #125/#146/#147. This is the concrete, non-anthropomorphic answer to the request to give the Brain a staged, infant-like developmental progression: capability maturity stages, not subjective development.
go: all seven modules reach REFLEX (deterministic, test-verified stimulus-response) with cited passing tests
brain/perception.py reaches PERCEPTUAL (habituation-based novelty normalization) with a cited test
brain/affect.py, brain/theory_of_mind.py, brain/hedonic.py reach ASSOCIATIVE (cross-event linkage: mood integration, trust update from track record, baseline dopamine adaptation) with cited tests

brain/hedonic.py, brain/theory_of_mind.py, brain/motor.py reach PREDICTIVE (explicit forecast + recorded error: RewardPredictionError, predict_action, MotorPrediction/MotorCalibration) with cited tests
brain/executive.py reaches STRATEGIC (plan comparison under a depletable, risk-like resource) with cited tests
every stage record was verified against real, currently-passing test files before this report was written -- no citation is a stale or hypothetical reference
every stage record carries blocked_claims (consciousness_claim, subjective_feeling_claim, neuroscience_equivalence_claim), inherited unmodified from HigherOrderCognitionService's own enforcement
hold: no METACOGNITIVE claim for any module -- none currently reports its own confidence/limits as a first-class output; brain/developmental/self_model.py exists but is not wired to these seven modules
no SELF_REPAIRING claim for any module -- none currently proposes a governed change to itself via DevelopmentalPlasticityDelta
no CONSOLIDATED claim for any module -- consolidation requires sustained real production evidence over time, which does not yet exist for modules with one PR's worth of history
no claim that any appraised/predicted/attributed value constitutes subjective experience, feeling, or understanding in any phenomenal sense
no claim that this curriculum makes the Brain 'complete' or equivalent to biological development

PERCEPTUAL/ASSOCIATIVE/PREDICTIVE/STRATEGIC stages deliberately not claimed for modules where the underlying capability does not exist -- documented per-module in NOT_YET_CLAIMED, not silently skipped
next_required_work: wire brain/developmental/self_model.py to surface per-module confidence/uncertainty reports, as the prerequisite for any future METACOGNITIVE claim

generate a real DevelopmentalPlasticityDelta from an actual LearningEvent produced by one of these seven modules, reviewed under brain/developmental/improvement_cycle.py governance, as the prerequisite for any future SELF_REPAIRING claim
accumulate real production-cycle history (not test-suite evidence) as the prerequisite for any future CONSOLIDATED claim
